items.title: Jerry Bergonzi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 7, 2022
items.q: I idolized. I’d like to be able to play like Paul Desmond.

ctx.x: He did not object to the fact that you played differently than some of his previous saxophone players, is that a good guess? © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-

Yes. He never told me once how to play. Not once. He never said yeah I want you to play more like Paul Desmond, who I idolized. I’d like to be able to play like Paul Desmond. Who wouldn’t? But that’s not the way I played. That’s not my personality. Yeah he never told me. And I think he appreciated that. And besides when you think about it, anybody who was into the Paul Desmond camp, you’re going to lose because nobody’s going to sound as good playing like Paul Desmond as Paul Desmond. Right? So I didn’t play…

Let me ask you about — you do some ensemble work at the New England Conservatory. Do you try to teach some of the things that the jazz bandstand practice, the elements of getting a gig and keeping a gig and bandstand etiquette. Is that something that you can teach in a rehearsal room?
